name: WarPaths
description: Online wargaming platform for professional and educational military strategy simulations. Supports multi-player campaign wargames with emergent operational outcomes. Offers browser-based access to structured wargaming scenarios used in professional military education and defense analysis contexts.
general_score_metric: scenario-specific outcome metrics (mission success rate / win rate / composite utility score)
reputation: emerging platform in the online professional wargaming space; demo version publicly accessible
notes: Browser-based platform enabling remote multiplayer wargaming. Targets both professional military education and serious gaming communities. Demo available at warpaths.io.
